messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up team — Gateflow (ISV) sent over their adapter + sample app. Raised a few items after quick smoke. We need to decide marketplace posture and the onramp checklist.
Darren Cole: What failed in smoke?
Leah Kim: Short summary: two issues. 1) adapter sends a nonstandard streaming header (X-chunk-size: 2048) which forces eager KV hydration for sharded LlamaIndex flows. 2) telemetry tags missing for tenant_id so costs show as 'unknown' in console.
Sam - Integrations: Repro steps I used:
```
curl -X POST https://gateway.redwood.internal/v1/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"adapter":"gateflow-alpha","model":"llama-13b","flow":"llamaindex-shard","stream":true,"input":"search helpdesk"}'
```
Sam - Integrations: Results: stream fallback to buffered flush, p95 +1.9s. Also telemetry event missing tenant ID.
Marta (Partner PM): Partner wants a marketplace slot next week. Can we do a "technical preview" listing if we add a clear badge and docs?
Tess - Marketplace: We can list as "Technical preview — streaming best-effort" but need legal OK and a short onboarding doc + terraform.
Lina Legal: For a "Technical preview" label, we need a short disclaimer and updated indemnity clause (partner acknowledges preview state). I can draft addendum by 2026-05-02.
Darren Cole: Proposed mitigation: implement a server-side clamp for chunk negotiation (256) and add a runtime telemetry shim to surface tenant_id from the adapter headers. That should fix both issues without requiring partner code changes.
Leah Kim: Agree. I can add clamp in gateway negotiation + unit tests. Also add a telemetry adapter that extracts X-tenant-id or falls back to Authorization metadata. Patch timeline: PR today, CI + H100 smoke tomorrow.
devops-bot: CI pipeline #6123 triggered for branch gateflow-clamp-256.
Sam - Integrations: I'll assemble a minimal terraform module and an onboarding runbook with steps: SSO, adapter registration, rate limits, support contact. ETA 2026-04-29.
Marta (Partner PM): I'll ask partner for 2 marketing screenshots and a short quote. If clamp lands and smoke is clean we can keep the slot.
Priya Singh: Can we capture perf numbers for both H100 and A10G? Partner will market H100 results. Need p50/p95 token latencies and GPU mem.
Leah Kim: Will run both and post a short CSV: model,batch,p50_token_ms,p95_token_ms,gpu_mem_gb. Target to post by 2026-04-30 morning.
Tess - Marketplace: Also need a lightweight "known issues" bullet list for the listing page. Drafting that once legal approves wording.
Darren Cole: Note for eng copy: emphasize that streaming is best-effort on preview adapters, recommend customers pin model versions and enable fallback policies. I'll produce a short blurb after Leah's numbers.
Leah Kim: CI shows a flaky teardown test, investigating. If it's just ordering we can still merge with a follow-up fix. Will post status update in 2 hours.
devops-bot: CI #6123 finished: unit tests passed; integration tests queued.
Priya Singh: Action items recap:
- Leah Kim: gateway clamp + telemetry shim PR, H100/A10G smoke, results by 2026-04-30
- Sam - Integrations: terraform + onboarding runbook 2026-04-29
- Lina Legal: preview disclaimer & addendum draft 2026-05-02
- Marta (Partner PM): collect screenshots + partner quote 2026-04-30
- Tess - Marketplace: listing draft + known-issues bullets pending legal, 2026-05-03
- Darren Cole: eng blurb + best-practice bullets after perf numbers 2026-05-01

Priya Singh: If all goes green we list Gateflow as Technical Preview and schedule joint blog the week of 2026-05-11. Otherwise we push. Thanks everyone.
